recommendation_reason: The measured GPU probe consumes about 16 images/s; 8 CPU workers supply about 64 images/s and leave CPU headroom. 12 workers supply about 90 images/s but do not raise the measured GPU processing ceiling and cost more worker startup time.
conditions: CPU-only real image loading, first 256 training records, 768, batch4, SHA verification and training augmentation. Other root diagnostics including a GPU probe may overlap, so results are a short readiness measurement, not end-to-end training throughput.
discarded_attempt: An early 12-worker launch briefly overlapped an 8-worker run. The 12-worker attempt was interrupted before data iteration. Both 8 and 12 were then rerun separately and the rechecked results are used here.
